speaker: diane_sterling
headline: DELIVERY IS A TRANSMISSION TEST.
deck: Budgets and contracts only matter if capital moves through execution into a usable public service.
quote: A funded programme is an input. Performance is what reaches the household.
facts: Appropriations establish capacity, not completed delivery.
Procurement converts budgets into executable obligations.
Operational performance determines whether assets become services.
Households experience the final output, not the accounting line.
takeaway: Economic credibility is the ability to convert allocated resources into repeatable delivery.
